Custom Side Gusset Coffee Bags: Structure, Capacity and Branding

Published August 24, 2026 · Buyer guide · By BestPackFactory

Quick answer

Side gusset coffee bags balance cost, standing stability and shelf presence. Confirm the gusset width against your fill weight, the barrier structure for your freshness target, valve placement and the front/back print panels. Approve a filled sample that stands well and seals reliably.

Gusset width sets the shelf look

A wider gusset makes a fuller, more stable bag but uses more film. Match the gusset to the fill volume so the bag looks full rather than collapsed or overstuffed, and confirm it stands on the shelf.

Barrier and freshness go together

Coffee loses aroma fast. Confirm the film structure matches your freshness promise, and validate with a storage test. The valve releases CO2; the barrier keeps oxygen out.

Print panels that sell coffee

Roasters buy on aroma and story. Full-color front print, a back panel for tasting notes and roast date, and a clean valve area create the shelf presence. Confirm print quality after lamination.

Filling and sealing fit

Confirm the bag opens wide enough for your filling line and that seals hold at your fill speed. Test filled bags for standing, sealing and transport behavior.

Buyer checklist

  1. Match gusset to fill weight
  2. Confirm barrier for freshness target
  3. Plan valve and print zones
  4. Test filling and sealing fit
  5. Approve filled samples

Frequently asked questions

What size bag do I need for 250g of coffee?

Capacity depends on bean density and bag structure; confirm the gusset and dimensions against your fill volume.

Do side gusset bags stand well?

With the right gusset-to-fill ratio they stand reliably; test filled samples.

Can the valve be printed over?

The valve area must stay clear of heavy print for adhesion; plan artwork around it.

What the Spec Means for Buyers

Side-gusset coffee bags expand when filled, giving roasters a printable front and back with a flat base for shelf display. A typical factory specification: laminate MOPP 20µm / VMPET 12µm / PE 80µm or PET 12µm / AL 7µm / PE 80µm, OTR ≤ 0.8 cc/m²·day, WVTR ≤ 0.8 g/m²·day, one-way valve Ø9–12 mm centered 35–55 mm below the top seal, PE zipper 6–8 mm, seal strength ≥ 35 N / 15 mm, and printing registration tolerance ±0.3 mm for gravure. Dimension tolerance is ±2 mm for flexible packaging. Capacity 250g, 500g or 1kg is confirmed by a density test with your actual coffee.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the dimension tolerance on a side-gusset bag?

The standard dimension tolerance for flexible packaging is ±2 mm unless a tighter value is agreed for the project.

What printing registration tolerance applies?

Multi-color gravure printing is held to ±0.3 mm registration on the finished bag.
